comparison.objective: Install a rack rail versus cut a can lid with a handheld rotary opener.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-rail support, compliant latching and screw driving versus sustained handle clamping coordinated with repeated key rotation around a rim.
comparison.success_condition: Persistent four-prong and screw retention versus a fully severed lid and removed, parked opener without tipping the can.
comparison.reason: The only commonality is bimanual coordination; continuous cutting-tool operation is not rail attachment. Candidate force limits remain unspecified.
